articles.title: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch

articles.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
articles.summary: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.

articles.title: While VCs crowd into San Francisco, Endeavor Catalyst raises $320M for founders ‘elsewhere’
articles.summary: Endeavor Catalyst just raised $320 million to keep backing founders outside Silicon Valley. Half the profits go back to the nonprofit that finds them.

articles.summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
articles.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

articles.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
articles.summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

articles.title: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
articles.summary: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.

articles.summary: The latest in our series of articles on venture funding to non-tech founders features a former magician's assistant and ballet dancer who's building cybersecurity software with $4.2 million in seed funding.

articles.title: There Was Never An Easy AI Era, And Investors Are Raising The Bar
articles.summary: As AI IPOs bring greater scrutiny, argues guest author Maor Farid, founder and CEO of Leo AI, investors will increasingly prioritize customer spending growth, sustainable margins and deployment efficiency over rapid revenue growth alone.

articles.title: North America’s Startup Funding Falls In Q3 As AI Giants Eye The Public Markets
articles.summary: In total, investors poured $92 billion into seed- through growth-stage rounds for U.S. and Canadian startups in the third quarter, per Crunchbase data. That’s a 35% decline from the prior quarter but up 50% from year-ago levels.

articles.title: ‘Where you come from shouldn’t dictate where you finish’: How Standard Chartered is taking on the banking industry’s class problem
articles.summary: Finance chief Darren Ellis is pushing socio-economic mobility up the agenda at Standard Chartered and, in doing so, is making the bank a more supportive and inclusive place to work.

articles.title: Nvidia’s secret to retaining staff? No org charts, a flat structure, and two extra days off every quarter
articles.summary: Over 19 years, Nvidia has evolved from a graphics-chip maker into one of the world’s most valuable companies. HR director Febe Punsalan says, despite these changes, the company is keeping its mission-driven, employee-led culture intact.

articles.summary: Liza Follert, head of people attraction for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, explains how employee feedback has shaped Siemens Healthineers’ approach to inclusion, retention and recruitment

articles.title: Microsoft shows off new Windows software, revamped for agentic AI
articles.summary: At an event in San Francisco, CEO Satya Nadella showed how Microsoft’s Windows operating system will be a box for AI agents, with many tasks running locally and not on the cloud.

articles.title: How Marriott’s leadership pipeline is helping it navigate Europe’s hospitality talent shortfall
articles.summary: Marriott International, ranked 15th on Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For – Europe list, focuses on employee development to attract and retain talent.

articles.title: Hilton is betting on people in an industry that can’t afford to lose them
